3. ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS OF THE PROPOSED ACTION
3.1.5 WASTE DISPOSAL
Page 3-14
Duke's DES comments submitted on January 5, 1976 proposed that part of the rock excavated from underground tunnels be used to construct an underwater weir in the Whitewater arm of Lake Jocassee downstream of the Bad Creek discharge. This weir is further discussed in Exhibit V, Appendix J, Amendment 2.
Section 3.1.5 has been revised
3.2.4.2 Water Quality
Page 3-28
The first paragraph mentions a flow augmentation system. The potential for augmenting flows in Howard Creek with water from the Bad Creek upper reservoir is discussed in Exhibit W. Appendix J. Amendment 2.
This information has been taken into consideration in revised Section 3.2.2.2.
Page 3-29
Paragraph two states that "at present it is not known what effect the operation of the Jocassee units alone will have on stratification in Lake Jocassee". Exhibit W, Appendix J, Amendment 2 presents data that show the effects of the Jocassee Pumped Storage operations on Lake Jocassee and are one of the basis for projecting how Bad Creek discharge will behave.
Section 3.2.2.3 has been revised.
